claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: June 24, 2020
claims.evidence_observations: The evidence tag next to the gun in the photo of the gun from scene reads '6-24-20'.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 0103 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states 'Carmen Timer 01:03:50' at the beginning of the video, indicating the time is approximately 0103 hours.

claims.claim_text: Location: 22800 block of Loumont Drive, Lake Forest, CA
Reporting Officer: Deputy M. Calder
Badge Number: 7831
Subject: Female, approximately 25-30 years old, dressed in dark clothing
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is difficult to determine the subject's gender or age with certainty. The person appears to be wearing dark clothing, but the claim specifies a female subject approximately 25-30 years old, which cannot be confirmed from the video alone.

claims.claim_text: Deputy M. Calder, Badge Number: 7831
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy R. Ruelas, but the claim refers to Deputy M. Calder. The video does not show Deputy M. Calder.

claims.claim_text: Deputy R. Vega
Deputy S. Whitfield
Deputy A. Navarro
No witnesses were present at the scene
On June 24, 2020, at approximately 0103 hours, Orange County Communications Center received a 911 call reporting a residential burglary at 22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest
The reporting party stated that someone had broken a rear window and entered the residence
The reporting party was a male caller who believed the intruder was still inside the home
Deputy Vega was dispatched to the call
Deputies Calder, Whitfield, and Navarro also responded
While en route, dispatch advised that the reporting party stated he was hiding in a bedroom closet
The call was subsequently disconnected
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states 'the line disconnected' at 02:59, indicating the call was disconnected.

claims.claim_text: The dispatcher's attempts to reestablish contact were unsuccessful
At approximately 0109 hours, I arrived on Loumont Drive and turned off my emergency lights
claims.evidence_observations: The timestamp in the bottom center of the video reads '01:12:31', which is after 0109 hours, and the deputy is seen exiting the vehicle and walking toward the residence.

claims.claim_text: I parked directly in front of 22851 Loumont Drive and exited my vehicle
claims.evidence_observations: The deputy is seen exiting the vehicle and walking toward the residence, consistent with parking in front of the residence and exiting.

claims.claim_text: Using my flashlight, I began walking eastbound along the north sidewalk toward the residence
claims.evidence_observations: The officer is seen walking eastbound along the north sidewalk with a flashlight, which aligns with the claim that he was walking eastbound along the north sidewalk toward the residence.

claims.claim_text: I heard a noise to my left and observed a female subject standing on the north sidewalk approximately 40 feet from my position
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a female subject standing on the north sidewalk approximately 40 feet from the officer's position, and she is dressed in dark clothing.

claims.claim_text: The subject was dressed entirely in black, including a black hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a female subject dressed entirely in black, including a black hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up.

claims.claim_text: I illuminated the subject with my flashlight and immediately observed that she was holding a black semi-automatic handgun in her left hand, pointed toward the ground
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer illuminating the subject with his flashlight and observing that she is holding a black semi-automatic handgun in her left hand, pointed toward the ground.

claims.claim_text: I drew my department-issued sidearm and began issuing commands
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer drawing his department-issued sidearm and beginning to issue commands, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: I yelled, "Drop the weapon! Let me see your hands! Get on the ground!"
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer yelling commands, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not respond and remained motionless
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject remaining motionless and not responding to the officer's commands.

claims.claim_text: I took cover behind the sedan
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer taking cover behind a sedan.

claims.claim_text: I broadcast over the radio that I had a subject at gunpoint
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer broadcasting over the radio that he has a subject at gunpoint.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Vega arrived at approximately 0110 hours and parked approximately 20 feet behind my position
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy Vega arriving at approximately 0110 hours and parking approximately 20 feet behind the officer's position.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Whitfield took a position behind Deputy Vega's vehicle
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy Whitfield taking a position behind Deputy Vega's vehicle.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0111 hours, Deputy Navarro arrived and took cover position near the front of my vehicle
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy Navarro arriving and taking cover position near the front of the officer's vehicle.

claims.claim_text: Over the following approximately ninety seconds, I repeatedly ordered the subject to drop the weapon and get on the ground
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer repeatedly ordering the subject to drop the weapon and get on the ground over approximately ninety seconds.

claims.claim_text: The subject stood still but appeared to be scanning the area, turning her head from side to side
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject standing still and appearing to scan the area, turning her head from side to side.

claims.claim_text: At no point did the subject make any verbal response to my commands or those of the other deputies
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject not making any verbal response to the officer's commands or those of the other deputies.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0111 hours and 30 seconds, the subject abruptly raised the handgun to shoulder level with both hands and aimed it directly at my position behind the sedan
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject abruptly raising the handgun to shoulder level with both hands and aiming it directly at the officer's position behind the sedan.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my firearm five times at the subject
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer discharging his firearm five times at the subject.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Whitfield simultaneously discharged his firearm three times
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy Whitfield discharging his firearm three times simultaneously with the officer.

claims.claim_text: The subject fell to the ground and the weapon came to rest beside her
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject falling to the ground and the weapon coming to rest beside her.

claims.claim_text: Deputies Vega and Whitfield approached the subject and secured the scene
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputies Vega and Whitfield approaching the subject and securing the scene.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Vega kicked the weapon away from the subject's reach
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Deputy Vega kicking the weapon away from the subject's reach.

claims.claim_text: Upon closer inspection, the weapon appeared to be a realistic-looking semi-automatic pistol
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the weapon appearing to be a realistic-looking semi-automatic pistol.

claims.claim_text: Deputies immediately began rendering first aid
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the deputies beginning to render first aid.

claims.claim_text: Orange County Fire Authority Engine #19 arrived at approximately 0119 hours and paramedics assumed medical care
The subject was transported to Mission Hospital by ambulance
The weapon recovered at the scene was later determined to be a Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, a realistic-looking replica handgun
The 911 call reporting the burglary had originated from the subject's own cell phone
No burglary had actually occurred at 22851 Loumont Drive
Patrol vehicle video recordings from responding units
Eight (8) cartridge casings recovered from scene
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows eight cartridge casings recovered from the scene.

claims.claim_text: One (1) Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, black
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows one Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, black.

claims.claim_text: Subject's clothing items with apparent blood
Subject's cell phone
One California Driver's License
Subject transported to Mission Hospital
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject being transported to Mission Hospital.

claims.claim_text: Scene secured and processed by OCSD crime scene investigators
OCDASAU investigators responded
Deputy Signature: M. Calder
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the deputy signing the report, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Date of Report: June 24, 2020
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the date of the report as June 24, 2020.
